==Part 6: Hunter==
'''3,300+ points, 181 tasks.'''

Whenever you get downtime, complete lobster, tuna, swordfish fishing tasks. They take longer than you'd expect, even with relics, but are worth good points.

'''Hunter contracts notes (early contract rush BEFORE unlocking Karamja):'''
'''Hunter contracts notes (V4 Blocklist Strategy):'''
* '''Initial Setup (Level 46):''' Turn OFF Back to Back in your settings. Grab a task from [[Guild Hunter Cervus (Adept)|Cervus]] and [[Guild Hunter Ornus (Adept)|Ornus]] ''before'' speaking to [[Huntmaster Gilman (Novice)|Gilman]].
* '''Adept Blocklist (Level 46–72):''' 
** Gilman: Block [[Snowy knight]].
** Cervus: Block [[Pyre fox]].
** Use Ornus as your primary Hunter, only doing his [[Embertailed jerboa]] tasks (Should only be Jerboa until 63). 
** ''Note:'' At 10 rumours completed, go to the roof and unlock the [[Basic quetzal whistle blueprint|Whistle Blueprint]]. Continue this setup to 72 Hunter.
* '''Expert Setup (Level 72–75):''' Get a task from [[Guild Hunter Aco (Expert)|Aco]]. If he assigns [[Sunlight antelope]], catch 25 then get a task from [[Guild Hunter Teco (Expert)|Teco]] instead. Only do [[Red chinchompa]] tasks.
* '''Expert Blocklist Update (Level 75+):''' Update your blocked tasks to the following:
** Gilman: Block [[Snowy knight]].
** Cervus: Block [[Sunlight moth]].
** Ornus: Block [[Pyre fox]].
** Aco: Block [[Sunlight antelope]].
** Teco: Should only receive red chins.
* '''Master Blocklist (Level 91–99) optional as it takes 3.5 hours:''' 
** Cervus: Block [[Sunlight moth]].
** Ornus: Block [[Carnivorous chinchompa|Red chinchompa]].
** Aco: Block [[Tecu salamander]].
** Teco: Block [[Sunlight antelope]].
** Use [[Guild Hunter Wolf (Master)|Wolf]] as your primary master. ''Make sure to keep the moths you catch during these rumours for Moonlight Moth Mixes.''
